key_concepts: Electricity is a form of energy associated with electric charges and their motion
Lightning is an example of static electricity in nature
Charging by friction occurs when two materials are rubbed together
Charging by induction charges an object without direct contact with a charged object
Charging by conduction is also called charging by contact
Charging by conduction involves contact between a charged object and a neutral object
During conduction, electrons move from a neutral conductor to a positively charged object
A neutral object touched by a positively charged object becomes positively charged
A neutral object touched by a negatively charged object becomes negatively charged
Objects charged by conduction end up with the same sign of charge
Conduction requires both objects to be conductors so electrons can move freely
Electric charge cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred; total charge is conserve
